diagnosisExecution.title: Diagnosis execution
diagnosisExecution.description: Verify whether completed optimization work has taken effect.

guidance.purpose: Turn confirmed diagnostic findings into trackable, verifiable optimization actions.
guidance.automatic: Address confirmed findings from diagnosis reports, answer summaries, competitor comparisons, and site audits.
guidance.manual: Break findings into optimization work orders with a clear owner, due date, and acceptance criteria.

keywordMatrix.title: Breakthrough matrix
keywordMatrix.description: Identify priority topics, questions, and content directions for breakthroughs.

guidance.purpose: Identify priority topics and content directions from brand questions, competitor performance, and existing content coverage.
guidance.automatic: Address questions and topics with weak brand mention, competitor advantage, or insufficient coverage.
guidance.manual: Set priority, target questions, and the facts or content direction to add, then turn them into work orders.

guidance.purpose: Manage public, trustworthy sources that support brand facts and improve externally verifiable coverage.
guidance.automatic: Address facts missing public evidence, cited but ungoverned URLs, and insufficient source coverage.
guidance.manual: Register, review, and associate website, industry-media, and case-study assets; plan source work without automatically publishing content.

technicalAdaptation.title: Website optimization
technicalAdaptation.description: Improve site and page configuration that affects AI access and understanding.

guidance.purpose: Improve the conditions for AI to crawl, access, understand, and cite website content.
guidance.automatic: Address technical and page issues that affect AI crawling, access, understanding, and citation.
guidance.manual: Fix robots.txt, sitemaps, structured data, page accessibility, and citable passages.

guidance.purpose: Plan content that fills question gaps using reviewed brand facts and diagnostic findings.
guidance.automatic: Address topics with missing facts, insufficient explanation, or competitor advantage in brand questions.
guidance.manual: Currently manage content topics, fact basis, and review plans only; do not generate or publish articles automatically.

guidance.purpose: Plot brand visibility and its change from completed diagnosis runs over time.
guidance.automatic: At least two completed diagnosis runs are required. Rerunning diagnosis automatically includes the newest result.
guidance.manual: Use this page only to choose a period and review the trend; no separate run is required.

rankTracking.title: Question tracking
rankTracking.description: Track brand mentions and competitor performance in priority questions.

guidance.purpose: Track brand mentions and competitor performance for priority questions across engines and markets over time.
guidance.automatic: Rerunning diagnosis automatically updates question, engine, and competitor performance.
guidance.manual: Optionally configure the questions, engines, and markets to track.

guidance.purpose: Compare diagnosis results before and after optimization work to identify changes that may be associated with completed work.
guidance.automatic: Rerunning diagnosis shows before-and-after correlation only; it cannot establish causal attribution automatically.
guidance.manual: Associate optimization actions or work orders and add manual attribution notes when needed.

guidance.purpose: Compare diagnosis results from predefined control and experiment groups to validate whether one optimization strategy is more effective.
guidance.automatic: A single diagnosis rerun does not automatically create a comparison experiment.
guidance.manual: Create control and experiment groups, define scope and success criteria, then run each group.

guidance.purpose: Use a selected baseline to continuously compare later diagnosis metrics and retain retest records.
guidance.automatic: A one-off manual retest can rerun diagnosis and add its result to later comparisons.
guidance.manual: For automatic recurring execution, configure frequency, scope, notifications, and enabled status.

1.title: Load previous baseline
1.detail: Read the latest diagnostic snapshot and rule version to establish this run's comparison baseline.
1.impact: 20 rules are comparable in this run
1.recommendation: This run will calculate changes against this snapshot.

2.title: Recrawl site evidence
2.detail: Crawl the entry page, robots.txt, sitemap, and linked site pages to collect diagnostic evidence.
2.evidence: sitemap.xml is available; 2 legacy campaign pages returned 404
2.recommendation: Redirect retired campaign pages to the corresponding evergreen content.

3.title: AI site reachability check
3.detail: Probe the entry page and key content with browser and AI crawler user agents for accessibility.
3.impact: GPTBot cannot access the site entry page
3.evidence: GPTBot request to https://aurora-beauty.example/ returned 403; browser UA returned 200
3.recommendation: Allow approved AI crawler user agents in the CDN / WAF, then rerun this step.

4.title: Audit pages and content
4.detail: Check structured data, canonical links, citable passages, and content coverage.
4.impact: Waiting for site evidence and access conclusions
4.recommendation: Continue automatically once site access checks are complete.

5.title: Sample AI answers
5.detail: Store answers and citation evidence for configured engines, markets, and question sets.
5.recommendation: Run authorized sampling after engine configuration is confirmed.

6.title: Verify rules and compare changes
6.detail: Compare the current evidence with work-order targets and historical baselines.
6.recommendation: Calculate passed, failed, and manual-review conclusions when evidence is ready.

7.title: Generate check results
7.detail: Generate a traceable snapshot, summary, and related findings.
7.impact: Waiting for all steps to complete
7.recommendation: Generate the diagnostic snapshot after all steps are complete.
